name: Explore-features empty state
purpose: Keep the 'explore further features' closing block on feature pages whose CMS feature list is empty: the header and link to all features stay, the slider is replaced by empty bars.
retrievalReason: CMS empty state of the explore-features slider (empty bars) rendered only when the feature list is empty; utility fallback, not content.
description: Page-local CMS empty state of the feature-page autotabs block (data-section 'kiki', data-variant 'empty'), padding 5rem top (3rem mob) / 2rem bottom. Top: the shared ExploreHeader in container-medium (28rem column: 1.5rem H2 and a primary 'see every feature' button, then a 2rem spacer). Below, inside the doubled gutter, two stacked full-width #dddddd bars each reading 'No items found.' (0.5rem gap). No tabs, slides or images.

evidenceNotes: ExploreEmpty takes no props; the heading (EXPLORE_HEADING), button label and bar text are literals in FeatureDetail.jsx. It renders on /lms/features/employee-experience and /lms/features/communication (featureDetailData.js `empty: true`), replacing the KikiTabs autotabs block.
ExploreHeader is shared with the non-empty KikiTabs block (passed as its `header`), so heading/button copy is identical on all 17 feature routes.
pages-manifest.json / CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md list these two routes with a normal 'autotabs-cta' section; the code renders this empty state instead.
